title: FERTRADO
description: Making complex EU fertilizer regulations easier to explore and understand.
details: Architected FERTRADO's internal regulatory navigator by serving a high-parameter Qwen model locally via Ollama, containerizing the entire application, and deploying it onto AWS infrastructure for reliable, production-grade access. The system couples a FastAPI backend with FAISS vector indexing to ground the model strictly in parsed EU compliance material, delivering low-latency, hallucination-free regulatory answers across the organization without third-party API dependencies. The underlying data ingestion and indexing architecture is fully scalable, allowing new policy frameworks, directives, and documentation to be added seamlessly as regulatory requirements expand.

title: CareerGenie
description: Turning real-world professional work into verifiable talent signals for recruiters, while helping candidates identify and bridge the skill gaps needed for their target roles.
details: Built automated candidate signal and upskilling workflows using n8n, JavaScript, and LLMs, integrating Laya/Jev for classification and external APIs for data ingestion.
highlights: GitHub Signal Engine. Turn repositories, commits and contributions into clear, verifiable technical hiring signals.
Peer-benchmarked gap analysis. Compare candidates with professionals at their target role and seniority to identify concrete skill gaps and next steps.
Data orchestration. Connected APIs, Laya/Jev and LLM prompt chains to clean, normalize, classify signals and deliver structured profile insights to downstream hiring tools.

title: Teleperformance
description: Automating end-to-end data science workflows in sandboxed environments and boosting time-series forecasting accuracy with zero-shot foundation models.
highlights: Data science agent. Implemented a DeepAnalyze-8B architecture that ingests raw data, plans and executes EDA, preprocessing and modeling, then compiles analytical reports inside an isolated sandbox.
Zero-shot forecasts. Benchmarked and integrated Google TimesFM, Amazon Chronos and IBM Granite against the existing ensemble, reducing sMAPE by 32% across key internal metrics without retraining.
Execution boundaries. Kept generated analytical code within strict local sandbox boundaries for privacy and controlled execution.

title: Infovirgin Technology Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
description: Automated reporting, built executive BI dashboards, and improved revenue and workload forecasting for operational decisions.
details: Data Science & AI Intern · April 2026 – July 2026
highlights: Automated data pipelines. Architected and deployed a Python ETL pipeline with Pandas, NumPy, and KNN imputation, reducing weekly reporting data preparation time by 75% and eliminating manual data entry discrepancies across departmental databases.

Executive BI dashboards. Designed and launched real-time interactive dashboards to replace static monthly Excel spreadsheets, giving leadership instant visibility into sales funnels, client acquisition, and operational KPIs.

Forecasting and resource allocation. Built ARIMA and moving-average models for revenue and workload forecasts. Replaced nested grid search with randomized search and rolling windows, cutting script runtimes from hours to minutes and reducing engineering bench time.

Data governance and architecture. Restructured operational analytics tables into a dimensional star schema and standardized Sales and Operations milestone definitions through unified SQL CASE logic, establishing a single source of truth across 45+ attributes.
